properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 9 at 4:46AM CDT until August 9 at 5:45AM CDT by NWS Twin Cities/Chanhassen MN
properties.description:
SVRMPX

The National Weather Service in the Twin Cities has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Southwestern Martin County in south central Minnesota...

* Until 545 AM CDT.

* At 446 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 10 miles southwest
of Sherburn, or 21 miles west of Fairmont, moving east at 25 mph.

HAZARD...Quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Damage to vehicles is expected.

* This severe thunderstorm will be near...
Ceylon around 515 AM CDT.

Other locations impacted by the severe thunderstorm include Dunnell
and Wilbert.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. This storm is capable of producing large hail.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 9 at 4:58AM CDT until August 9 at 5:45AM CDT by NWS Des Moines IA
properties.description:
SVRDMX

The National Weather Service in Des Moines has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Emmet County in northwestern Iowa...

* Until 545 AM CDT.

* At 457 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located over Wallingford,
or 6 miles southeast of Estherville, moving northeast at 15 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage
to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Estherville, Okamanpedan Lake, Iowa Lake, Swan Lake, Ingham Lake,
High Lake, Armstrong, Wallingford, Gruver, Dolliver, Fort Defiance
State Park, Okamanpedan State Park, Wolden County Park, and
Estherville Municipal Airport.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 9 at 4:44AM CDT until August 9 at 5:15AM CDT by NWS Sioux Falls SD
properties.description:
SVRFSD

The National Weather Service in Sioux Falls has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Southeastern Jackson County in southwestern Minnesota...

* Until 515 AM CDT.

* At 444 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Jackson In
Jackson County, moving northeast at 20 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and half dollar size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage
to roofs, siding, and trees.

* This severe thunderstorm will remain over mainly rural areas of
southeastern Jackson County, including the following locations...
Alpha.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

To report severe weather, contact your nearest law enforcement
agency. They will send your report to the National Weather Service
office in Sioux Falls.
